results.snippet: Foundation model developers are among the world's most important companies. As these companies become increasingly consequential, how do their transparency practices evolve? results.snippet: AbstractThe extension of large language models (LLMs) from purely textual inputs to multimodal inputs—images, video, audio, andstructured data—represents one of the most consequential transitions in contemporary artificial intelligence. results.title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
results.snippet: Personalization is essential for general-purpose robots to transition into household environments and achieve true practicality. While general robotic manipulation has been extensively studied, personalized robotic manipulation (PeRM) lacks a controlled benchmark for separating task completion from preference satisfaction. We introduce LIBERO-PeRM, a benchmark for preference learning in embodied agents. LIBERO-PeRM studies five questions: 1) how policies follow preferences in zero-shot settings; 2) how they learn single preferences from demonstrations; 3) how efficiently they acquire preferen…

results.title: LIBERO-Industry: Benchmarking Robotic Manipulation under Industrial Process Constraints
results.snippet: Industrial manipulation in flexible manufacturing, e.g., high-mix, low-volume (HMLV) electronics assembly, requires robot policies to adapt to changing products and production conditions. Such settings impose industrial process constraints, including product variants, moving material flows, finite execution windows, and tight geometric tolerances. However, existing evaluation frameworks do not systematically capture these constraints when assessing generalist robot policies. To address this gap, we introduce LIBERO-Industry, a novel benchmark built on the widely used robot learning benchmark…

results.snippet: In this technical report, we detail our first-place solution for the 2024 Waymo Open Dataset Challenge's semantic segmentation track. We significantly enhanced the performance of Point Transformer V3 on the Waymo benchmark by implementing cutting-edge, plug-and-play training and inference technologies. Notably, our advanced version, Point Transformer V3 Extreme, leverages multi-frame training and a no-clipping-point policy, achieving substantial gains over the original PTv3 performance. Additionally, employing a straightforward model ensemble strategy further boosted our results. This approac…

report_md:
# 机器人操作与世界模型：前沿增量快照（2024-2026）

**日期**：2026-11-13（UTC）  
**领域**：具身智能 / 机器人操作 / 世界模型 / VLA  
**检索源数量**：30 条可引用证据（含 arXiv 预印本、会议技术报告、基准论文）  
**方法论**：frontier-watch（增量追踪）+ evidence-grading（证据分级）+ deep-research（四阶段流程）

---

## 1. 进展与热点（Progress & Hotspots）

> **一句话增量判断**：近 1-2 年世界模型在机器人操作中的核心增量在于：**从“视频生成式世界模型”向“几何感知/高斯溅射/注意力可解释”的可控世模演进**，并出现首批**百万小时级真机轨迹训练的 VLA 基础模型**（Xiaomi-Robotics-1、Meituan-Robotics-0）[1][2]；基准层面新增**个性化偏好**（LIBERO-PeRM）与**工业流程约束**（LIBERO-Industry）两大受控评测套件[3][4]。

### 1.1 世界模型架构演进（近 1-2 年关键节点）

| GEM-4D: Geometry-Enhanced Video World Models for Robot Manipulation | 2026 | 未标注机构 | arXiv 预印本 v4（2026-05），引用数待核实 | arXiv cs.RO 预印本，未经同行评审 | 中：几何增强世模为近期热点 | ★★★★☆：显式引入 4D 几何一致性，解决视频生成世模的 3D 不一致 | [5] | 以几何先验约束视频扩散，提升操作仿真保真度 |
| GWM: Towards Scalable Gaussian World Models for Robotic Manipulation | 2025 | 未标注机构 | arXiv v2（2025-08），引用数待核实 | arXiv cs.RO 预印本 | 中：高斯溅射表征在世模落地的早期探索 | ★★★★☆：可微渲染+世模联合训练，Sim2Real 潜力大 | [6] | 用 3D Gaussian Splatting 作为世界模型的状态表征 |
| SPIRE: Synergistic Planning, Imitation, and Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Manipulation | 2024 | 未标注机构 | arXiv v1（2024-10），引用数待核实 | arXiv cs.RO 预印本 | 中：长时程规划+模仿+RL 三元融合 | ★★★★☆：给出规划-模仿-RL 协同范式，长任务基线 | [7] | 分层规划器+世模 rollout，解决长时程信用分配 |
| Action Flow Matching for Continual Robot Learning | 2025 | 未标注机构 | arXiv v2（2025-04），引用数待核实 | arXiv cs.RO 预印本 | 中：流匹配在持续学习中的新应用 | ★★★☆☆：持续学习视角下的动作生成新范式 | [8] | 用流匹配替代扩散，降低推理延迟 |
